remarks: Welcome to 9885 Seymour Street in Houghton, NY. This custom-built log home sits on 4.5 acres and boasts 2,324 square feet of living space, three bedrooms, and 2.5 bathrooms on a quiet, dead-end street. Entering through the front door brings you into the foyer, which features a conveniently located half bath and an office area. The living room and kitchen feature an open concept and include a dining area. The space is perfect for hosting gatherings and helping the home feel intimate. The more formal dining area is located towards the front of the house with a large set of windows that overlooks the front yard and woods. The primary bedroom is off the living room and features a walk-in closet and a full bath. Heading down the hall brings you to the walk-in pantry, second full bathroom, laundry room, and two additional bedrooms. Bring your ideas and tools to the over 2,000 square feet of unfinished basement space — game room, home theater, or gym. The garage features space for two vehicles and workbench space. Outside, enjoy a concrete driveway, a private yard with two gazebos, and a front porch for quiet mornings. The property backs up to woods with room to hunt right on your own land. The roof is 2 years old, and the furnace is 5 years old. Perfectly situated within 70 minutes of both Buffalo and Rochester and just 15 minutes from Letchworth State Park, this location offers the tranquility of small-town living with easy access to major cities and world-class outdoor recreation. Don't miss out on this one!
